I checked the P6 / true-M, GNN and cluster-HT text of the appendix, Section 5.2 and 5.4 against `results/` and the code. Two statements need changing; the rest matches.
  > 
  > **Change**
  > 1. Appendix, true-M paragraph: 'Pooled over the five mechanisms with M finite or zero, including (b) and (e)'. The 585 block cells are **seven** mechanisms: (a), (b), (c), (e), (f), (g), (h) (81 cells each, 99 for (g)); five of them (a, c, f, g, h) have a finite true M (423 cells) and two ((b), (e), 162 cells) have the empty bound. Write 'seven'.
  > 2. Appendix, 'a diagnostic found after the failure…': 'M-hat is about 0 without noise and 6.9, 26 and 112 at d=5,20,80' for (a) and (f) are the **original cells** (72 cells per mechanism and d; `p6_original_mhat_diagnostics.csv`). The block gives 7.0, 25 and 109 (`p6_confirmatory_mhat_diagnostics.csv`), the numbers the next sentences use. Say 'on the original cells' for the first triple, or use the block's.
  > 
  > **Checked and correct**: cluster HT (132 cells; ht75 / ht100 never below the regression or cluster DM; median log ratios 1.66, 2.66 to the regression and 1.05, 2.64 to cluster DM; Hájek q=0.75 81% / −0.10 / 68%, q=1 22% / 94% on 114 cells); GNN paragraph and Section 5.2 (66 / 5 / all five in (d); 57 / 27; medians and ranks; 84 of 91 for the adaptive Hájek); P6 numbers (0.990 at 8.4, 0.963 at 3.3, strata 3.8 and 11.6, 0.938 / 0.821 / 0.153); true-M figures (0.913 at 1.04 times, 0.942 at 2.2, 0.885 / 0.895, 0.591 at 0.61, 0.857 / 1.15, lean 0.794 at 0.93 and 0.877 at 31 times).
  > 
  > **Mine, pushed on `dev` (c75de90)**: `REPRODUCE.md` was out of date (it said no GNN was run and cluster HT not implemented). It now has the `run_gnn.py` and `run_ht.py` commands, the script-to-table rows for `make_gnn`, `make_ht`, `p6_interval`, `p6_true_m`, `p7_confirm`, `hk_compare`, the corrected departures, and run times; `aggregate_all.sh` now runs `p6_true_m` on the block and the original cells. Please rebase candidate 13 on it.
